statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (F G : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ), let oddChars := @Finset.filter (DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (fun χ => χ.Odd) (fun χ => Classical.propDecidable χ.Odd) Finset.univ; let T := fun (W : (ZMod N)ˣ → ℂ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) => Finset.univ.sum (fun a : (ZMod N)ˣ => W a * χ (a : ZMod N)); 2 * oddChars.sum (fun χ => star (T F χ) * T G χ) = (N.totient : ℂ) * Finset.univ.sum (fun a : (ZMod N)ˣ => star (F a) * (G a - G (-a)))

plain_statement.zh: 固定正模数 N 和单位群上的两组复权 F、G。取全部奇狄利克雷特征，混合矩的两倍等于 φ(N) 乘以 F 的共轭与 G(a)−G(−a) 的配对和。
plain_statement.en: For each positive modulus N and complex weights F and G on its units, twice the mixed moment over all odd Dirichlet characters equals φ(N) times the sum of conjugate F(a) against G(a)−G(−a).

brief.zh: 将同类与相反类的正交关系相减，再展开两组权的有限和。计入全部奇特征，包括非本原特征。这个等式保留了补数 N−n 对应的反射项。
brief.en: Subtract character orthogonality at equal and opposite unit classes, then expand the two weighted sums. Include imprimitive odd characters. The reflected term records the class of the complementary summand N−n.
